title: What America’s mobile networks are made of: U.S.-based R&D, sensing and the path to 6G
summary:
• Ericsson’s U.S. based R&D is a crucial part of our global technology leadership – working in critical areas like AI, network security, semi-conductor design, 6G and open networks.
  • Ericsson is deeply embedded in the US ecosystem, helping to ensure the U.S. is the technology leader for secure networks that will power the 6G-AI digital stack in decades to come.
